name: Spirit Lantern

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A ghostly lantern hovers by you for 10 minutes, shedding Dim Light 60 feet. When an enemy dies in its light, the lantern captures a fragment of its spirit (up to your spellcasting modifier). As a Bonus Action you can spend a fragment on a creature you can see within 60 feet: it makes a Constitution save against 4d8 + your spellcasting modifier Necrotic damage (half on a success); or an Undead regains that many Hit Points; or attacks against it have Disadvantage until the start of your next turn.
